# ataila_customer (Data Source)

One customer, looked up by exactly one of `id`, `short_name` or `gitlab_group`. Archived customers are found too; check `status`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Exactly one of id, short_name or gitlab_group.
data "ataila_customer" "example" {
  short_name = "EXAMPLE"
}

output "example_status" {
  value = data.ataila_customer.example.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `gitlab_group` (String) GitLab group of the customer, `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,30}$`; also the slug of its primary tenant. No customer's group may be a hyphen-prefix of another's (`example` and `example-labs`). **Frozen.** Set it to look the customer up by GitLab group.
- `id` (String) Customer id, assigned by the platform. Set it to look the customer up by id.
- `short_name` (String) Short name, `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,15}$`, for example `EXAMPLE`. **Frozen.** Set it to look the customer up by short name.

### Read-Only

- `billing_tier` (String) `INTERNAL` (the default) or `PAYING`.
- `created_at` (String) When the customer was created, as the platform reports it.
- `customer_index` (Number) The customer's index, 1-999, used in derived names and address plans. Omit it and the platform allocates the next free one (one above the highest ever used, never below 2). **Frozen.**
- `default_email_tier` (Number) Default mailbox tier for the customer: 1, 2 or 3 (the default).
- `edition` (String) `sp` (service provider, the default) or `enterprise`. **Frozen.**
- `long_name` (String) Display name, 3-80 characters. Quotes, backslashes and control characters are refused because the name is copied into generated project files.
- `notes` (String) Free-text notes, up to 2000 characters.
- `primary_contact_email` (String) E-mail address of the primary contact. A platform user with this address becomes a `member` of the primary tenant when the customer is created. The platform stores the domain in lower case; the provider keeps the spelling of the configuration.
- `primary_contact_name` (String) Name of the primary contact, 2-80 characters.
- `primary_tenant_id` (String) Id of the tenant created with the customer. It can never be deleted.
- `status` (String) `active`, `suspended` or `archived`.
